investment will result in an immediate increase in net tangible book value per Class A Ordinary Share, based on the assumptions described

million, or $12.69 per share. Our historical net tangible assets are the amount of our total tangible assets less total liabilities. Historical
net tangible assets per share is our historical net tangible assets divided by the number of outstanding share as of March 31, 2026. Our pro forma net tangible assets represent our
total tangible assets less total liabilities. Pro forma net tangible assets per share equal this amount divided by the pro forma number
